test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.**

The king covered the hole with a huge stone.

options.text: The hole has been covered by the king with a huge stone.
The hole was covered by the king with a huge stone.
The king was covered by the hole with a huge stone.
A huge stone was covered by the king with a hole.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The hole was covered by the king with a huge stone.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the **active voice of simple past tense.**
 
• **Simple past tense:** It is defined as an action started in past, finished in past, and has no relation to the present.
 
• **Structure**:
 
 
• (Active voice) Subject + the second form of verb + object
 
• (Passive voice) Object + was/were + the third form of verb + Subject.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• She wrote a letter. (Active voice)
 
• Here, the subject is 'she', the object is 'letter' and the main verb is 'wrote' which is the second form of the verb 'write'. To convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject and object will change their places and will be connected with a linking verb followed by the third form of the main verb.
 
• A letter was written by her. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Thus, in the above-given sentence, the subject of the sentence i.e.** 'the king'** will exchange its place with the object of the sentence i.e. **'the hole'**, and will be connected with the linking verb and the third form of the main verb.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 

**Correct sentence:**__ *The hole was covered by the king with a huge stone. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject: **a person or thing that is being discussed, described, or dealt with.
 
• **Object: **a person or thing to which a specified action or feeling is directed.
